## Redacted diagnostics / 脱敏诊断

Do not attach firmware, extracted components, DCP/LUT files, body backups,
calibration, serials/hash bindings, credentials, or private photos. Keep original
unknown-outcome journals locally; do not retry a camera write solely to report it.
不要上传固件、提取组件、DCP/LUT、机身备份、校准、序列号／绑定摘要、凭据或私人照片。
未知结果的原始日志留在本地，不要为了反馈问题而重复写入相机。
